title: Yozakura Quartet
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In the town of Sakurashin, where humans and youkai live side by side behind a protective barrier, four teenagers run a 'life counseling office' to help residents. Hime, the super-strong interim mayor, mind-reader Ao, Kotoha, who can create objects with a word, and ordinary-seeming Akina handle everything from possessed dogs and violent intruders to helping at a kindergarten. The long series (34 volumes) builds from episodic cases into larger supernatural conflicts.
life_message: A community thrives when its young people take responsibility for protecting and helping their neighbors, whoever they are.
